newsitem.title: PERU: Andean Development Corp plans $300 mln bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Andean Development Corp plans $300 mln bond issue.

text.p: The Andean Development Corp (CAF) plans a $300 million bond issue in Europe or Japan later this year, its president Enrique Garcia said.
"This $300 million will possibly be distributed between the markets of Europe or Japan," said Garcia, adding that the CAF had already placed $200 million of bonds in U.S. markets this year.
Garcia was speaking to reporters at a ceremony in Lima to mark the CAF's incorporation as a partner into the Peruvian government's loan body COFIDE.
He added that the CAF, the financial arm of the Andean group of countries, had approved $2.5 billion of loans this year for Latin American and Caribbean countries.

The CAF finances public and private sector projects in its member countries. The Andean group is made up of Bolivia, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru and Venezuela but the CAF membership extends to Brazil, Chile, Mexico and Trinidad and Tobago who are not Andean members.
